verdict.rationale: The repo documents pieces of a packaging workflow: a validator that checks invocation contracts and plugin version parity, the plugin metadata layout (Cursor plus a portable root plugin.json, built by a Nix flake), and a way to test an unpublished checkout with an isolated config and local marketplace path. There is no evidence of a skill-authoring spec, SKILL.md template, or meta-skill that would guide an agent to create a new skill end to end. missing for 10: documented skill-authoring spec or template, a meta-skill for creating skills, an end-to-end new-skill walkthrough, independent or hands-on corroboration.
